rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that strongly holds people's attention.

example.english: This documentary is so riveting that I don’t want to turn off the TV.
example.traditional: 呢套紀錄片真係好吸引人，睇到我唔捨得熄電視。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 gei2 luk6 pin2 zan1 hai6 hou2 kap1 jan5 jan4 tai2 dou2 ngo5 m4 se2 dak1 sik1 din6 si6

rows.note: Use this especially for a performance, show, film, or visual display that is very entertaining to watch.

example.english: Tonight’s play was so riveting that the audience stayed silent throughout.
example.traditional: 今晚個舞台劇真係好睇，睇到觀眾全程都唔出聲。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan1 go3 mou5 toi1 kek6 zan1 hai6 hou2 tai2 tai2 dou2 gun1 zung3 cyun4 cing4 dou1 m4 ceot1 seng1
